clues: Founded by an immigrant financier (A.P. Giannini) in California, the first successful bank credit card (BankAmericard), the world's largest agricultural lender, the Charles Schwab acquisition for about $55 million, CEO Sam Armacost taking over at 40 after A.W. Clausen left for the World Bank, and rival Wells Fargo all point to BankAmerica in 1983.
